name: Lantern room
summary: a warm, crowded room: fairy lights along the walls, orange curtains, plants, a round rug and a day bed heaped with cushions
description: String lights, plants and too many cushions. Warm and crowded.

name: Homely
summary: a homely room: fairy lights, framed photos, plants on the shelves, a yellow bedspread and a gray service locker
description: Photos, plants and a yellow bedspread next to the service locker.

name: Bookish
summary: a bookish room: full shelves, a desk lamp over notes, lavender bedding and a gray service locker
description: Shelves of books, notes on the wall, lavender sheets.

name: Tidy
summary: a tidy, orderly room: a red patterned rug, framed pictures in a row, a clean desk, everything put away
description: Everything in its place on a red patterned rug.

name: Bunk room
summary: a shared room with two bunk beds, posters, a teal dresser and a red rug; it was meant for more than one
description: Two bunk beds and posters: a room meant for more than one.

name: Reading corner
summary: a lived-in room: a navy armchair, a low table, pink sheets, papers pinned over the desk
description: A navy armchair, a low table and papers over the desk.

name: Severe
summary: a severe, dim room: heavy black and red curtains, a black bedspread, a leather armchair, a rack of blades and riding crops on the wall
description: Black and red drapes, a leather armchair, a rack on the wall.

name: Sweet
summary: a sweet, bright room: a pink floral bedspread, yellow cushions, fresh flowers and framed pictures
description: Pink flowers on the bed and fresh ones on the desk.

name: Blackout
summary: a dark, bare room: black furniture, closed blinds, gray sheets, one small lamp
description: Black furniture, blinds down, one small lamp.

name: Tatami
summary: a Japanese-style room: tatami floor, sliding paper screens, a low table, paper lanterns
description: Tatami, paper screens and a low table.

name: Messy
summary: a messy room: clothes on the bed, posters everywhere, cans and magazines on the floor, a green rug
description: Clothes on the bed, cans on the floor, posters everywhere.

name: Gilded
summary: a lavish room out of place on a base: a tufted headboard with gold trim, a gilded mirror, a vanity, a patterned rug
description: A gilded headboard and a vanity mirror. Corporate money.

name: Lab notes
summary: a study room: a whiteboard full of equations, a laptop, labeled boxes, navy curtains and a round pink rug
description: A whiteboard of equations and labeled boxes.

name: Shrine
summary: a quiet room with a small shrine: icons on the wall, a hanging charm, candles by the bed, a red rug
description: Icons on the wall, a charm and candles by the bed.
